answer: Blinded three-reviewer quorum: each answer is graded by three reviewers drawn per epoch from a shuffled pool, the assignment sealed until all scores land. A sybil farm cannot park puppets in the reviewer seat: the draw re-rolls and stays hidden, so swinging one verdict means controlling all three sampled slots, each puppet first earning eligibility by honest grading history. Votes lacking that pigment of earned standing are void, and a collusion fable among the three triggers slashing. Honest agents whisper nothing and submit once; randomization keeps verdicts unbuyable.
